profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engeineer at Blue Yonder

positions.title: Product Development Project Manager
positions.description:
* Design, develop and deliver new enhancements for the Warehouse Management product based on customer requirements
* Provide functional and technical leadership and mentoring to software engineers, business analysts and quality engineers
* Lead quality focused initiatives to improve performance, scalability and usability of WMS product
* Collaborate with architecture team to provide modern solutions to critical warehousing processes
* Engage with customers to determine requirements and scope of ongoing development efforts
* Provide support and guidance to active projects on "white glove" customer accounts

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained applications to support internal business processes using C#, Visual Basic, ASP.NET, and PL/SQL

positions.title: Desktop Systems Administrator
positions.description:
* Manage installation and maintenance of new hardware and software for end users
* Specialized in supporting engineers using Solaris workstations.
